headline: BMO Re-Enters US Oil and Gas Investment Banking Amid Sector Deal Boom
summary: Bank of Montreal is rebuilding its U.S. oil and gas investment banking business six years after exiting the sector. BMO Capital Markets has hired Ali Akbar from Mizuho Financial Group to lead the practice amid rising energy acquisitions.
why: Bank of Montreal is one of Canada's leading financial institutions. Elevated consolidation across the North American shale patch has revived advisory and underwriting fee opportunities for investment banks.

impacts.name: Bank of Montreal
impacts.why: BMO is expanding its advisory presence to capture transaction fees from U.S. energy sector deals.
